newsitem.title: UK: Eurobond market closes for New Year holiday.
newsitem.headline: Eurobond market closes for New Year holiday.

text.p: The primary market saw no activity on Tuesday, with most European centres closed for the New Year holiday and others open for a half-day only.
January 1 is a market holiday, and Eurobond business will resume on Thursday.
DSL Finance NV plans to issue a 1.0 billion mark 10-year Eurobond on January 2, via joint lead managers Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and SBC Warburg, it said on Monday.
Dealers said the 10-year mark sector looked favourable, with the European Investment Bank, KfW and Austria also mooted. Jumbo dollar bonds were also likely in the coming weeks.
